definitions.explanation: The act of applying color to something, whether literally (painting, dyeing, food decoration) or figuratively (adding character or flair to something).

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{色|いろ}づけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦パセリ→パセリ：21585_paseri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use parsley for adding color to the dish.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{粘土|ねんど}→粘土：19435_nendo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{色|いろ}づけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The children are coloring the clay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{色|いろ}づけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再現|さいげん}→再現：09777_saigen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: By colorizing the photo, they vividly recreated the old scenery.

notes:
Combines ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color) with づけ (the noun form of ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧, to attach/apply). Refers to the process of adding color in cooking, art, photography, and other fields.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色|いろ}づけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to add color, to colorize
- {色|いろ}づけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use for coloring
- {食紅|しょくべに}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{色|いろ}づけ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to color with food dye
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧な{色|いろ}づけ: natural coloring

USAGE:
Particularly common in cooking contexts where garnishes or ingredients are added for visual appeal rather than flavor. Also used in photography (colorizing black-and-white images) and crafts.

RELATED WORDS:
- {色付|いろづ}き: becoming colored, taking on color — describes the natural process (e.g., autumn leaves)
- ⟦{着色|ちゃくしょく}→着色：13708_chakushoku⟧: coloring, pigmentation — more technical/formal term
- ⟦{彩|いろど}り→彩り：12506_irodori⟧: color arrangement, variety of colors — emphasizes aesthetic effect
